issues.where: crops 1–2, the hook and the long, backlit stem
issues.what: The stem has nearly parallel sides and little shading across its broad face. The hairs mostly register as a uniform line of bright pinpricks, giving the hook the look of a molded tube.
issues.fix: Vary the stem's thickness and cross section through the bend, give the front face more rounded shading, and vary the length, spacing and direction of individual hairs.

issues.where: crops 1 and 5, the pale green arch emerging at soil level
issues.what: The in-focus green surface is conspicuously smooth next to the soil, and its lower silhouette changes direction in an abrupt, stepped notch over the dark clod.
issues.fix: Round out the silhouette, give the surface subtle microstructure, and vary which small grains overlap the sprout at emergence.

issues.where: crops 1 and 3, the yellow-green tissue and split seed coat
issues.what: The exposed tissue reads as a smooth, uniformly colored insert, and the two shell lips terminate in hard, stepped tips.
issues.fix: Add soft thickness and backlit color variation to the tissue, and make the shell break thinner and more irregular.

issues.where: crop 5, the sides of the soil opening beside the stem
issues.what: The clod faces on either side turn into dark, smooth, vertically stretched grooves, an abrupt change from the granular detail on top at similar depth.
issues.fix: Carry granular relief down the faces and break up the steep sides with smaller loose clods and partly buried grains.

issues.where: crop 7, the paired grass blades and their dew
issues.what: The blades are smooth green ribbons with little variation beyond a central stripe. Several bright beads sit just off the silhouette without a visible attachment to the blade.
issues.fix: Give the blades varied folds, thickness and transmitted light, and seat each droplet visibly against the surface before applying depth of field.

issues.where: crop 8, the boundary between the blue-gray background and the brown field
issues.what: A broad gray band ends in a nearly straight horizontal transition with little variation in depth, making the horizon read as a separate blurred backdrop.
issues.fix: Break up the transition with irregular distant terrain and carry atmospheric haze gradually from the field into the skyline.
